rationale: X has the strongest hero: a large tight serif headline, a clean floor-plan card and tilted info cards, all with a consistent warm palette. Y is tidy and complete, with a booking form and a live floor plan, but its card grids and dark bands follow the usual SaaS template. Z is the most inventive, with its metric dot-grids, day chips and event calendar, but its hero card overlaps and hides the floor-plan caption and clips 'Darkroom', which hurts polish.
